name: codex-cli-bus
description: Local message bus and control plane for coordinating multiple Codex CLI agents.

interface.shortDescription: Send tasks, messages, and status checks across local Codex CLI agents.
interface.longDescription: Codex CLI Bus provides a file-backed local protocol, registry, and command-line tools for coordinating multiple Codex CLI agents from one active session.
defaultPrompt: 启动 cli-b 常驻 worker，让它自动领取任务。
查看所有 Codex CLI agent 的状态。
让 cli-b 检查当前任务是否卡住。
